note: The bookstore's shelves: 16 bookcases: three of the most read (Project Gutenberg's most downloaded), then one per skill, 4 shelves x 10 books, shelved by author surname then title. Every book is US public domain (first published 1930 or earlier; translations pre-1931) and on Project Gutenberg (pg = its ebook number, English text). y = year first published in the original language (negative = BCE); pages = rough page count for spine thickness; col = spine cloth colour.
